name: David and Goliath
hook: A shepherd, a giant and a sling: the underdog story Jeopardy retells more than any other.

facts.label: the valley of Elah
facts.statement: The First Book of Samuel sets the fight in the valley of Elah, between the Philistine giant Goliath and the young Israelite David.

facts.label: six cubits and a span
facts.statement: The King James Bible puts Goliath at six cubits and a span tall, a giant by any measure.

facts.label: a sling
facts.statement: David brings down the heavily armed Goliath with a shepherd's sling, the weapon also usable as an arm splint.

facts.label: the Philistines
facts.statement: Goliath is a Philistine, the Aegean people who also count Delilah among their villains and who steal the Ark of God.

facts.label: Jonathan
facts.statement: Jonathan, Saul's eldest son, befriends David soon after the Goliath kill.

facts.label: Andrea del Castagno's David
facts.statement: Andrea del Castagno painted David on a shield with Goliath's severed head at his feet.

facts.label: David and Goliath
facts.statement: The pair became a byword for the underdog: Malcolm Gladwell used them in a book title, and a 1951 film cast 7-foot wrestler Walter Talun as Goliath.
